items.title: Leonardo Da Vinci
items.description: Discover the life and genius of Leonardo da Vinci in this stunning graphic novel. Explore the world of Leonardo da Vinci, the Renaissance master, through vivid illustrations and compelling storytelling. This graphic novel delves into his inventions, artistic achievements, and the political intrigues that shaped his life. From the Mona Lisa to his groundbreaking inventions, witness the journey of a true visionary. Perfect for art enthusiasts, history buffs, and graphic novel readers, this biography brings Da Vinci's world to life. Uncover the secrets behind his masterpieces and the challenges he faced in a world of shifting powers and artistic rivalries. Will Da Vinci's genius transcend the trials of his time?
